The upstream notice states that Creative Commons is not a law firm; the work
is offered as-is without warranties; the affirmer waives copyright and related
rights to the greatest extent permitted by law, with a royalty-free,
irrevocable public-license fallback where the waiver is ineffective. No
trademark or patent rights are waived.
